# Zryth

> Zryth is the team businesses outsource their AI development to. We design, build and deploy custom AI and software, or deploy AI products we have already built.

Zryth works in two ways: (1) AI Transformation — we go into a business, find where AI can create real ROI, implement it, train the team, and measure the impact; (2) Products & Services — ready-to-deploy AI products, or custom AI and software built around what a business needs (custom AI automation, custom software development, document AI, voice AI).

Zryth is based in Noida, India, and works with clients in milling/manufacturing, finance & audit, and publishing/education.

## Company

- [About Zryth](https://zryth.com/about): Who Zryth is and how it works with businesses.
- [AI Transformation / Success Stories](https://zryth.com/transformation): How Zryth transforms businesses with AI, and real client transformation stories (Oswaal Books, Agra Rollers, ARC & Associates).
- [Get started](https://zryth.com/get-started): Book a free discovery audit or a free AI seminar.

## Case studies

- [Running a Mill on Phone Calls and Memory](https://zryth.com/case-studies/mill-software): How Mill Software connected procurement, reconciliation and sales into one system for a flour mill.
- [Audits That Used To Take Days, Now Take Hours](https://zryth.com/case-studies/audit-firm-transformation): How FinanceAuditor.ai cut audit time by 60% for a CA firm.
- [One Publisher, Every Stage Rebuilt With AI](https://zryth.com/case-studies/publisher-ai-transformation): How Oswaal Books used AI across content, warehousing and a direct-to-student product.

## Products

- [FinanceAuditor.ai](https://zryth.com/products/finance-auditor): AI-powered audit platform — Tally, GST and TDS reconciliation, auto-generated financials and tax audit reports.
- [Mill Software](https://zryth.com/products/mill-software): Procurement, reconciliation, sales, dispatch and billing for the milling industry, in one system.
- [Oswaal AI](https://zryth.com/products/ai-education): AI learning hub for students — chapter-wise content, AI chat, adaptive tests, mind maps and podcasts.
- [Learning](https://zryth.com/products/learning): Platform to run corporate or institutional training and learning from one place.

## Research

- [The Bills Nobody Was Checking](https://zryth.com/research-work/mill-software-bill-verification): Applied research on automated bill verification for the milling industry.
- [The ₹12 Question](https://zryth.com/research-work/mock-test-question-extraction): Applied research on the cost and accuracy of AI + OCR question extraction from mock-test PDFs.
